reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that registers 25 bundled agent skills for reusable engineering workflows, including requirements clarification, planning, implementation, testing, debugging, code review, research, and handoff.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 注册一组用于需求澄清、规划、实现、测试、调试、代码评审、研究与交接的工程智能体技能。
summaries.en: Registers a collection of agent skills for DeepSeek Harness covering requirements clarification, planning, implementation, testing, debugging, code review, research, and handoff.

capabilities: registers and exposes bundled agent skills
provides guidance for planning, specification, ticketing, implementation, code review, testing, debugging, and research
may guide agents to modify repository files, run project checks, and interact with issue trackers or external services
